data.title: 克洛伊 · 爱因兹贝伦家的早餐战争
data.description: 餐桌前，她伸长筷子抢走伊莉雅盘子里的煎蛋，动作快得只剩残影；被瞪之后露出得意的小恶魔笑，却把自已盘子里的培根默默分了过去——争归争，照顾归照顾。
data.action: 餐桌前，她伸长筷子抢走伊莉雅盘子里的煎蛋，动作快得只剩残影
data.promptProse: Chloe reaches across breakfast with chopsticks to take fried egg from Illya’s plate, then quietly leaves bacon on the spare dish, a mischievous grin in her orange eyes. Keep Illya outside the frame and retain Chloe’s pale-pink hair, blue apron, peach long-sleeved shirt and loose brown trousers. The medium view includes the near plate rims and table edge. A low kitchen cabinet runs behind her chair, with its upper counter visible above the chair back. Morning light preserves her warm brown skin and brightens the food; chopstick shadows cross the tabletop, while the cabinet’s recessed panels remain quieter and darker.
